verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents Automations that run prompts automatically at recurring times. Each run creates a chat and goes through the normal completion pipeline. The Computer ecosystem also documents scheduled tasks such as "run the tests every weekday at 9" or "check the deploy hourly", so this is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on schedule syntax, job management (pause/edit/history) and multi-step workflow chaining beyond a single scheduled prompt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times.
Each run creates a chat and executes through the normal chat completion pipeline
Run a prompt on a schedule: "run the tests every weekday at 9", "summarize new files every Monday", "check the deploy hourly".
Schedule a task that runs the test suite every weekday at 9 and reports failures with the error output.
